subject: Interview Marathon: routing, buffer windows, and mandatory breaks
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Interview Marathon: routing, buffer windows, and mandatory breaks

Team —

We have Priya Shah's full-day virtual onsite next Wednesday (06/19). We need to lock panel sequencing and mandatory rest windows so we don't burn people out in the marathon. Attached is Candidate_Itinerary_v2.pdf and an initial panel rotation matrix. High-level constraints:

- 4 interviewer blocks (45m, 45m, 30m, 30m) with 15–20m buffer between blocks for notes and short breaks.
- One mandatory 30m break after block 2 (candidate + interviewer) — required per hiring guidelines for >3hr days.
- Cross-timezone overlap: Priya is on ET; we are PDT. Keep heavier cognitive sessions earlier for candidate (coding + system design).

Proposed sequence (first pass):
1) 9:30–10:15 PT — System design (Mina)
2) 10:35–11:20 PT — Deep product/PM + behavioral (Marissa)
3) 11:50–12:20 PT — Coding pair (Tessa)
4) 12:40–13:10 PT — Cultural fit / wrap (Laura)

Questions for you:
- Can Tessa do the 3rd block (short coding) and own the pairing doc?
- Marissa — can you swap to earlier if we need to front-load product questions?
- Do we want a warmed-up interviewer (10m pre-call) assigned to shadow the first 20m to ensure audio/video pass?

Please reply with availability adjustments by EOD today.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Candidate_Itinerary_v2.pdf)

----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview Marathon: routing, buffer windows, and mandatory breaks

Laura —

Thanks, this looks good. A couple quick notes:
- I can move to the earlier slot (2) but prefer to keep product + behavioral together (I can do product first, then behavioral wrap).
- Tessa is available for the 3rd block but asks for the coding prompt 24h in advance if possible (so she can prepare the pairing harness).
- Strong +1 on a 10m pre-call — I can do that for the first interviewer (9:20 PT).

Small tweak to timings to give a clearer lunch window for Priya on ET:
1) 9:30–10:15 PT — System design (Mina)
2) 10:30–11:15 PT — Product + behavioral (Marissa)
[30m mandatory break — 11:15–11:45 PT]
3) 11:45–12:15 PT — Coding pair (Tessa)
4) 12:30–13:00 PT — Cultural fit / wrap (Laura)

I updated the Panel_Rotation_matrix.xlsx with the proposed times and added the 10m pre-call owner.

-Marissa

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@talentmail.com>, Hyun Park <hyun@recruitingco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Interview Marathon: routing, buffer windows, and mandatory breaks

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for agreeing to meet with us on Wednesday, June 19. Below is the confirmed schedule (times PT / ET in parentheses). We intentionally included a 30-minute mid-day break so you have time to rest and refuel. If any of the time windows are problematic, reply and we'll adjust.

Final schedule (PT / ET):
- 9:30–10:15 PT (12:30–1:15 ET) — System design with Mina Haddad (lead)
- 10:30–11:15 PT (1:30–2:15 ET) — Product + behavioral with Marissa Cole (lead)
- 11:15–11:45 PT (2:15–2:45 ET) — 30-minute break (mandatory)
- 11:45–12:15 PT (2:45–3:15 ET) — Live coding pair with Tessa Morgan (lead)
- 12:30–13:00 PT (3:30–4:00 ET) — Cultural fit & wrap with Laura Bennett (lead)

Logistics:
- Zoom links will be sent 10 minutes before each block via calendar invites (look for the invites from laura_bennett@redwood.com).
- Please have a stable connection and a quiet space for the coding session; we'll share the pairing doc ahead of the coding block.
- Candidate packet (itinerary + FAQ) attached.

Any dietary/accessibility notes? Hyun — please relay if Priya needs anything else on our side.

Looking forward,
Laura Bennett
Hiring Manager — Platform
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Candidate_Itinerary_v2.pdf)

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@talentmail.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Hyun Park <hyun@recruitingco.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 12:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Interview Marathon: routing, buffer windows, and mandatory breaks

Hi Laura (and team) —

Thanks — schedule looks good and I appreciate the break. A few quick things:
- I can do the 9:30 PT start time fine.
- I have a gluten allergy — nothing major but I wanted to flag it for the lunch/break if there's any planned shared food.
- For the coding pairing: is there any prep or language preference? I typically use Python but can do JS if needed. Also, is the pairing prompt delivered via a shared doc or in the Zoom?

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Senior Backend Engineer (candidate)
priya.shah@talentmail.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview Marathon: routing, buffer windows, and mandatory breaks

Thanks for the quick turnaround, team. Final notes after Priya's reply:
- Priya confirmed — gluten allergy noted (Hyun, no catering needed but if any gift cards are sent, note preference).
- Tessa: pairing prompt will be posted to the shared Drive 24h before the interview and we'll default to Python unless candidate requests otherwise (Priya prefers Python).
- 10m pre-call owner: Marissa will do 9:20 PT check-in to confirm audio/video; calendar invite sent.
- I've updated Panel_Rotation_matrix.xlsx and locked the calendar invites (look for the updated invites with Zoom links).
- After the day, please add quick debrief notes (one-liners: strengths, risks, hire/no-hire) to the shared doc within 2 hours so we can meet for a 30m alignment at 4:00 PT on 6/19.

Attachments: Panel_Rotation_matrix.xlsx (contains final times & ownership)

Appreciate the rapid coordination.

Laura Bennett
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
